summary: Full text of the isolated-Zynamite crossover (70 healthy adults, single 300 mg dose; sponsor Nektium, with employee and consultant authors) shows better global task accuracy versus placebo (p<0.001), with no mood effect, in an explicitly exploratory study with no pre-defined primary outcome. Under Dr. Pham's primary-endpoint rule it may contribute without prespecified certainty, so it is the one eligible context, limited to acute Focus & Mental Clarity. The two exercise trials combine Zynamite with luteolin or quercetin and get no credit under her consistency rule.

applicability.studied_population: Healthy adults aged 18-45 given a single 300 mg Zynamite dose (PMID 32717999); exploratory acute accuracy/attention findings only.

identity.standardization: Mangifera indica leaf extract: mangiferin 60-65%, homomangiferin 3-5%

population.description: 70 healthy young adults in the per-protocol sample (37 women, 33 men; mean age 26.9, range 18-45).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo (maltodextrin)-controlled crossover, single dose, washout >=7 days; COMPASS and CDB tasks and POMS at 30 min, 3 h and 5 h; linear mixed models with Bonferroni-adjusted planned comparisons; explicitly no pre-defined primary outcome subset.

outcomes.name: Global accuracy of performance improved versus placebo (main effect F(1,335)=22.8, p<0.001; 30 min p=0.03, 3 h p=0.02, 5 h p=0.009), with improvements in CDB attention tasks.

limitations: All task findings exploratory; paper explicitly did not prespecify small primary outcome subset.
Per-protocol exclusions, task-level data removal and multiple outcomes.
Sponsored by Nektium, with employee/consultant authors.
Exercise combination trials are separate and do not establish isolated material exercise efficacy.

Per Dr. Pham's 2026-10-28 primary-endpoint rule this exploratory, non-prespecified finding may contribute but carries no prespecified-primary certainty; single acute dose in healthy young adults, not sustained benefit. Credit limited to acute attention/accuracy (Focus & Mental Clarity).
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

dose.administration_frequency: single dose; assessments 30 minutes, 3 hours, 5 hours
dose.reported_regimen: 300 mg assigned material/day; see source-specific frequency

normalization.basis: Whole assigned material daily mass from primary Methods; not a marker or active-equivalent conversion.

identity.name: Zynamite mango leaf extract combined with peanut-husk luteolin extract; not isolated Zynamite.

population.description: Twelve physically active men; double-blind crossover with low/high-dose subgroups and 3–4-week washout.

outcomes.name: Selected sprint performance and oxygen-extraction findings favored the combinations; dose equivalence and isolated-mango effects not established.

limitations: Retain combination identity and acute/prolonged conditions; no generic cognition or all-purpose branded efficacy transfer.
No credit: Zynamite combined with peanut-husk luteolin; per Dr. Pham's consistency rule a combination study does not qualify the isolated branded ingredient.

identity.name: Zynamite 140 mg plus quercetin 140 mg, with or without sunflower lecithin 420 mg.

population.description: Forty physically active adults,20 men and 20 women; randomized crossover of three treatments.

outcomes.name: Repeated-sprint peak power increased in active combinations; no added lecithin advantage was demonstrated.

limitations: No isolated-Zynamite replication or proof of ingredient equivalence.
Single acute task context, not sustained everyday cognitive benefit.
No credit: Zynamite combined with quercetin (with or without lecithin); per Dr. Pham's consistency rule a combination study does not qualify the isolated branded ingredient.
